definitions.explanation: Food stored for use during emergencies such as natural disasters, power outages, or evacuation situations. Designed to have a long shelf life and require minimal preparation.

examples.japanese: {非常食|ひじょうしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{備蓄|びちく}→備蓄：07589_bichiku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{非常食|ひじょうしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{賞味期限|しょうみきげん}→賞味期限：06076_shoumikigen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}しよう→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: Let's regularly check the expiration dates on our emergency food.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧、{三日分|みっかぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{非常食|ひじょうしょく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}して→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧おくこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{推奨|すいしょう}→推奨：12907_suishou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It is recommended to keep three days' worth of emergency food and water in case of an earthquake.

notes: Common collocations: {非常食|ひじょうしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{備蓄|びちく}→備蓄：07589_bichiku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to stockpile emergency food), {非常食|ひじょうしょく}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧ (emergency food kit). Japan's frequent natural disasters make {非常食|ひじょうしょく} a common topic in daily life, especially around September 1 (⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧, Disaster Prevention Day). Typical items include canned bread, instant rice, and energy bars. Related: ⟦{保存食|ほぞんしょく}→保存食：14976_hozonshoku⟧ (preserved food — broader term for any long-lasting food), {携帯食|けいたいしょく} (portable food).
